preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) representing the number of strings.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) > 0 and all(c.islower() for c in line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines contains a non-empty string composed only of lowercase Latin letters.
The total length of all strings does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the size of the largest subgroup where all strings are suffixes of a common string t.

postconditions.expression: all(si.endswith(sj) for si in strings for sj in strings if si != sj and si in selected and sj in selected)
postconditions.description: For the selected subgroup (of size int(stdout)), there exists a string t such that every string in the subgroup is a suffix of t. Here, `strings` is the list of all input strings, and `selected` is the subset of strings of size int(stdout).

postconditions.expression: not any(len(selected) > int(stdout) for selected in [subset for subset in combinations(strings, k) for k in range(int(stdout)+1, n+1)] if all(si.endswith(sj) for si in selected for sj in selected if si != sj))
postconditions.description: The output integer is the maximum possible size of such a subgroup. Here, `combinations` is the Cartesian product of all possible subsets of the input strings.
